stories.title: De la función a la fantasía: la bomber es la chaqueta joya de la temporada

en.title: From Function to Fantasy: The Bomber Jacket is the Jewel of the Season
en.summary: The aviator bomber jacket, popular in 2016, is experiencing a resurgence with reinvented designs featuring luxurious fabrics, unexpected proportions, and exuberant finishes for the current season.

stories.title: Alejandro Rojas-Marcos busca el reencuentro con los rivales políticos de toda una vida: “Tengo 86 años. Me gustaría dejar esto arreglado”

en.title: Alejandro Rojas-Marcos Seeks Reconciliation with Lifelong Political Rivals: "I Am 86 Years Old. I Would Like to Leave This Settled"
en.summary: The former founder of the Andalusian Party and ex-mayor of Seville believes reconciliation with longtime political opponents is possible through forgiveness and letting past grievances go.

stories.title: Buques de guerra marroquíes entraron en aguas de Ceuta coincidiendo con la llegada masiva de inmigrantes

en.title: Moroccan Warships Entered Ceuta Waters Coinciding with Massive Immigrant Arrivals
en.summary: Morocco's navy vessels entered Spanish-controlled waters off Ceuta at the same time as a surge in migrants, prompting Spain's navy to deploy a frigate to counter the incursions.

stories.title: "Tengo miedo, no salgo de casa para nada": Ceuta espera a los Reyes ya sin asentamientos pero con barrios en pánico

en.title: "I Am Afraid, I Do Not Leave My House at All": Ceuta Awaits the King and Queen Without Camps but with Neighborhoods in Panic
en.summary: Ceuta faces overcrowded migrant centers and residents in distress following arrivals, with some inhabitants barricading homes and migrants sleeping outdoors, as the Spanish royal family prepares a historic visit.

stories.title: Un nuevo ataque de hutíes contra el aeropuerto de Riad deja un muerto y 11 heridos tras la muerte ayer de 12 personas

en.title: New Houthi attack on Riyadh airport leaves one dead and 11 wounded following 12 deaths yesterday
en.summary: Houthi forces attacked Riyadh airport, causing casualties. The airport suspended operations following the incident and previous attacks.

stories.title: La personalidad de Ferrera y el valor sincero de Román, por la Puerta Grande

en.title: Ferrera's personality and Román's sincere courage, carried out through the Puerta Grande
en.summary: Bullfighters Antonio Ferrera and Román exited through the Puerta Grande at Las Ventas after a notable performance with challenging bulls from Adolfo Martín.

stories.title: El humorista Pepe Colubi cuenta que tiene párkison: “En cierta manera, es salir del armario”

en.title: Comedian Pepe Colubi reveals he has Parkinson's: "In a way, it's coming out of the closet"
en.summary: Comedian Pepe Colubi publicly disclosed his Parkinson's diagnosis in a radio interview to increase awareness of the disease and reduce personal pressure.

stories.title: Una tarde para la historia en Las Ventas: Ferrera y Román elevan el toreo a la cumbre

en.title: A historic afternoon at Las Ventas: Ferrera and Román elevate bullfighting to its peak
en.summary: Bullfighters Ferrera and Román were carried out on shoulders through the Puerta Grande after delivering exceptional performances against challenging bulls from Adolfo Martín.

stories.title: Doble Puerta Grande en Las Ventas: Antonio Ferrera y Román protagonizan una tarde apasionada y libre

en.title: Double Puerta Grande at Las Ventas: Antonio Ferrera and Román star in a passionate and free afternoon
en.summary: Two bullfighters achieved the honor of exiting through the Puerta Grande gate at Madrid's Las Ventas bullring during an afternoon performance. The event featured notable displays of skill and bravery from both matadors.

stories.title: Pepe Colubi hace público que tiene parkinson: “Tengo algo para echarse a temblar”

en.title: Pepe Colubi publicly announces he has Parkinson's: "I have something to shake about"
en.summary: Spanish comedian Pepe Colubi publicly revealed his Parkinson's diagnosis, which he has lived with for over two years. He emphasizes the importance of maintaining a positive attitude toward the disease, drawing inspiration from his father's experience.

stories.title: Los hutíes no dan tregua a Riad y vuelven a atacar el aeropuerto

en.title: Houthis continue assault on Riyadh with fresh airport attack
en.summary: Houthi forces launched another attack on Riyadh's airport, killing 12 people and wounding 300 in one of the most severe strikes in Saudi Arabia's history.

stories.title: Ceuta se prepara para la visita de los Reyes

en.title: Ceuta prepares for the Kings' visit
en.summary: Ceuta undertook cleaning and decorative preparations in anticipation of a royal visit over the weekend.

stories.title: Frux capta 350 millones y prepara un nuevo fondo para 'data center'

en.title: Frux raises 350 million and prepares new data center fund
en.summary: Frux Capital, a private debt manager specialized in real estate, closed its third fund with commitments of 350 million euros, 60% more than the previous one. The firm is also preparing a dedicated 200-million-euro vehicle focused on data centers.

stories.title: Iberia pide activar un nuevo control de pasaportes en la T4 para ganar vuelos de largo

en.title: Iberia requests activation of new passport control at T4 to gain long-haul flights
en.summary: Iberia seeks to activate additional passport control facilities at Terminal 4 for non-Schengen flights that currently lack staffing. The airline industry estimates this could increase capacity by approximately 50 daily flights.

stories.title: Volvo disparará rentabilidad con las ventas de Lynk & Co

en.title: Volvo will boost profitability with Lynk & Co sales
en.summary: Volvo will distribute vehicles from Lynk & Co, owned by Chinese conglomerate Geely, through its dealership network. The arrangement is expected to increase sales volume and profit margins for Volvo dealers.

stories.title: Pensiones, agua y Europa: así quiere cambiar Burnham Reino Unido

en.title: Pensions, water and Europe: how Burnham wants to change the United Kingdom
en.summary: British Prime Minister Burnham announces plans in his early weeks to adjust pensions, increase public control over essential services, and encourage more young people to enter the workforce.

stories.title: IESE, ESCP e IE, en el 'top 15' de mejores MBA a ejecutivos

en.title: IESE, ESCP and IE, in the 'top 15' of best executive MBAs
en.summary: Three Spanish business schools rank among the world's top executive MBA programs, with IESE ranked third globally, IE at number 13, and ESCP with a Madrid campus at fifth place.
